announcements.title: Aniraku runs on you
announcements.banner: V5.9 (Beta) is out. Downloads rebuilt — again — because your silence is the only bug I can't fix.
body:
Hey everyone… 👋

V5.9 (Beta) just landed. Downloads were rebuilt from the ground up — twice — because anime providers apparently rotate their whole video pipeline more often than I rotate my sleep schedule. Quality switching got smarter, sharing finally opens the app instead of a 404 graveyard, and saved episodes now play even when your Wi-Fi is showing off.

If Aniraku worked when you needed it — mail me. If it broke — mail me twice. Bugs, missing anime, feature ideas, or just a plain "hey, it works": every message lands in my inbox and every one of them is fuel for the next fix. Silence, meanwhile, is how a project quietly dies at 3 a.m. Don't make me haunt the issue tracker alone.

Still looking for a couple of kind souls to help grow a proper Discord and Telegram community. I'm the quiet guy who wants everyone to watch anime in peace — not the one managing welcome channels — so a hand setting things up right would mean a lot.

And if you can, a small Patreon pledge keeps the servers alive and the developer caffeinated. Bug reports are accepted. Compliments are hoarded. Both are read.

Now go enjoy some anime.

— the guy who still hasn't slept enough
